properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: Broken TODAY, not in 2035: this is a live defect, not a quantum migration item, and it does not wait for the post-quantum timetable. Replace immediately -- SHA-256 or SHA-3 for hashing, AES-256-GCM for encryption.

properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: Internet-reachable: an adversary can collect this traffic today without first getting inside the estate, which is what makes harvest-now- decrypt-later practical rather than theoretical. Migrate ahead of internal systems carrying the same algorithm.

properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: Prioritise by Mosca's inequality: this asset's data lifetime plus its migration time is measured against the CRQC horizon. A positive gap means data encrypted today is already exposed to harvest-now- decrypt-later, and migration cannot wait for the deadline.

properties.name: ecdat:x_years_basis
properties.value: data_class=Personal (knowledge/data_classes.yaml); a policy default, not a statutory retention period

properties.name: ecdat:y_years_basis
properties.value: ESTIMATE (heuristic): base 3y + 2y hard-coded penalty. Modelled from configurability, not measured.

properties.name: ecdat:z_years_basis
properties.value: ESTIMATE (global parameter): years until a cryptographically relevant quantum computer. Contested and adjustable; not a measurement.

properties.name: ecdat:actions

properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: Critical information infrastructure: migrate this high-priority system ahead of the general timetable. The CII deadline is 2028-12-31, a full year before general full adoption.

properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: Quantum-vulnerable cryptography must be replaced by the national full-adoption deadline of 2029-12-31, whatever the sector.

properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: NIST deprecates 112-bit-classical asymmetric cryptography (RSA-2048 and RSA-3072 among them) after 2030 and DISALLOWS it entirely after 2035. Deprecated means "may be used but the risk is accepted knowingly"; disallowed means it may not be used at all. Plan to complete migration before 2030, not before 2035.

properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: Replace with a post-quantum algorithm chosen by USAGE: ML-KEM (FIPS 203) for key establishment and key transport, ML-DSA (FIPS 204) for signatures, or SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) where a conservative hash-based signature is preferred. Increasing the key size does not help.
